title: PAINT issue: PTN008544731

author: marcfeuermann
body: Hi Val, After analyzing the phylogenetic tree corresponding to these genes, I found that SPAC14C4.10c is present in this family, but in a distant node (see attached figure, pink node). The annotations have been propagated to three nodes that are likely to have originated from ancient duplications. I have restricted the annotation to the two nodes that have experimental evidence. Therefore, distantly-related SPAC14C4.10c should no longer have these two annotations in the future. I hope this answers you question.
